Nicht nur die Rennfahrer können auf den Strecken Waffen bekommen, jeder von ihnen verfügt auch über individuelle Fähigkeiten!

name: First Steps for Quest 2
summary: Mache deine ersten Schritte in der VR und lerne deine Controller in dieser kurzen Erfahrung kennen, die dir die ganze Kraft von Oculus zeigt.

name: Carly and the Reaperman
summary: Niemand kann ganz ohne Hilfe aus der Unterwelt entkommen. Schnappt euch einen Freund und rennt, springt und löst Rätsel mit ihm auf dem Weg in die Freiheit in diesem preisgekrönten Koop-Rätsel-Platformer!

name: Bounce Shot
summary:
The party never stops with Bounce Shot!!!

Clear your opponents cups first and win! Challenge your friends or make new ones, with rooms that allow up to 8 players to join. 

Bounce Shot, a version of a popular American collegiate game, can be played  1v1  or in teams of 2. Each team then takes turns attempting to throw balls into the opponent's cups. If a ball lands in a cup, the cup is removed from the table. The first team to eliminate all of the opponent's cups is the winner.

name: Tank Arena: Ultimate League
summary:
- Tank Arena: Ultimate League bringt aufregende Updates!
- Deathmatch-Revolution: Von Pulse Tower zu einem Deathmatch.
- Neues Lounge-Erlebnis: Steige im Ranking auf und spiele Mini-Games.
- Training Ground: Teste 8 Panzer und ihre Fähigkeiten.
- Epische Features: Bildet 4er-Teams für futuristische Kämpfe.
- Soziale Interaktion: Triff neue Freunde im Lounge und füge sie hinzu.

name: Acron: Attack of the Squirrels!
summary:
ACHTUNG: Es handelt sich um ein VR-Spiel mit hohem Suchtpotenzial und muss mit mindestens einer weiteren Person gespielt werden, die dem Spiel über ein Mobilgerät beitritt. Das benötigte Handyspiel für iOS und Android ist kostenlos.

Hast du das Zeug dazu, die goldenen Eicheln in diesem nussig-verrückten Multiplayer-Partyspiel von Resolution Games zu beschützen? Oder bist du eher hibbelig wie ein Eichhörnchen?

name: Out of Scale: A Kurzgesagt Adventure
summary: Journey through 5 levels of scale ranging from molecular to mountain to clean up the aftermath of a lab test gone, well, slightly wrong. On your adventure, you’ll be joined by STEVE, the lab’s AI assistant, and will be the first to try out his newest invention, Shrink-o-gen. Scanning and scaling your way through the environment, you’ll learn about the different rules that apply to each realm, and have to deal with giant ants, fungi & tardigrades taking over the city.

name: Mannequin
summary:
Mannequin ist ein Stealth-VR-Spiel für bis zu 2 gegen 3 Spieler.

Zwei Elite-Agenten jagen Mannequins: Aliens, die sich als menschliche Statuen tarnen.

Sie überfallen unachtsame Agenten und können sie mit der kleinsten Berührung einfrieren lassen. Agenten nutzen daher High-Tech-Scanner, um die Mannequins zu enttarnen und zu erschießen. Wer ist Freund, wer ist Feind? Wer versehentlich einen Menschen trifft, kann nicht mehr schießen! Welches Team gewinnt das Katz-und-Maus-Spiel?

name: Gravity League
summary:
Welcome to the future of ball games! 

In a world where gravity is no longer a limitation, the Gravity League has become the ultimate test of skill and endurance for athletes from all corners of the galaxy.

The rules are simple: 2 players, 1 ball, zero gravity - the first player to get 11 goals wins.

So strap on your Gravity Gloves and get ready to take on the competition!

name: Loco Dojo Unleashed
summary: Enter the whimsical wooden world of Loco Dojo & step up to Grand Sensei’s ‘Table of Trials’ to pit your silliest skills against friends or strangers in this hilariously competitive multiplayer party game. Take turns to spin the wheel & move your counter around the dojo’s game board, acquiring strategic prizes & launching ludicrous trials in which to compete with your rival players to prove yourself as a master of martial madness! No friends? No problem! Solo Dojo and Ten Trials Tests awaits you!

name: Real VR Fishing
summary:
Real VR Fishing ist eine entspannende Angelarkade mit fantastischer Grafik und Szenerie, die du mit Freunden genießen kannst.

Angel, wie es dir gefällt! Erlebe Stippangeln oder Nervenkitzel beim Raubfischangeln. Wassertiefe und verbesserte Angelmechanik verleihen dem Spiel mehr Tiefe.

name: Snow Wars
summary: Snow Wars VR is a multiplayer, casual VR shooter set in a charming winter landscape. Experience beautiful handcrafted graphics and wield several unique weapons, each with different mechanics. Immerse yourself in four engaging modes, each featuring unique terrain and tactical advantages. For solo enthusiasts, the game includes the challenging "Defend the Portal" mode. Join the snowy fun with up to 8 players!

name: Figmin XR | Mixed Reality
summary:
Create, Collect & Play in Mixed Reality!

Figmin XR is a fun spatial computing application that lets you create your own mixed reality scenes. Multiplayer supported.

name: First Steps
summary: Mache deine ersten Schritte in der VR und lerne deine Controller in dieser kurzen Erfahrung kennen, die dir die ganze Kraft von Oculus zeigt.

name: ForeVR Darts
summary:
Alle deine Lieblings-Darts-Spiele: 01 Series, Double-Out 01 Series, Count-Up und Cricket!

Alle können mitspielen – leichte und mittlere Zielassistenten helfen beim Werfen! Auf „Schwierig“ können Profis Darts in VR auf realistische Weise erleben!

+ 4 Hallen
+ 65 Dartpfeile
+ 3-stufiger Zielassistent
+ 5 herausforderbare Profi-NSC in jeder Halle
+ YouTube-Jukebox
+ Reihum-Spiel

Erlebe die vollendete Handverfolgungs-Technologie von Oculus im besten Spiel, das mit Händen gespielt wird: Darts!

name: MarineVerse Cup
summary:
Try sailing, learn & race in iconic sailing locations. Master various sailboats.

Join a vibrant community and connect with fellow sailors.

MarineVerse Cup is crafted for simulation enthusiasts. Start with a Dinghy and progress to a Yacht.

When you are ready, test your skills in a competitive setting.

After the race, unwind in Free Sailing mode and watch a sunset in VR.

Happy Sailing!

name: GOLF+
summary:
The ultimate VR Golf experience and the official VR Golf game of the PGA TOUR!

**Available on QUEST 2, 3, and Pro**

⛳️ Iconic Courses: 3 Free courses and 15+ real-world destinations available for purchase including Pebble Beach.
🏌️ Multiplayer: Play with friends, or join public rounds.
📈 Performance Feedback: Stats, strokes gained data, and handicap system.
🏆 Competitive Play: Compete on the GOLF+ TOUR.
🎯 Diverse Modes: Match Play to Skins, to weekly challenges and Topgolf Las Vegas.

name: Star Trek: Bridge Crew
summary: Das speziell für VR entwickelte Spiel „Star Trek: Bridge Crew“ versetzt Sie und Ihre Freunde in das Herz eines Raumschiffs, wo jede Aktion and jede Entscheidung, die ihr gemeinsam als Offiziere der Föderation trefft, das Schicksal Ihres Schiffes und Ihrer Crew entscheidet.

name: BIG SHOTS
summary: Rüstet euch aus, schließt euch zusammen und vernichtet eure Gegner! Werde zum ultimativen Mech-Piloten in BIG SHOTS!

name: Ghostbusters: Rise of the Ghost Lord
summary:
WHO THEY GONNA CALL? YOU!

Schnall dein Proton-Pack um und erlebe mit Meta Quest, wie viel Spaß und Nervenkitzel die Geisterjagd bringt!

WERDE EIN GHOSTBUSTER!
Benutze ikonisches Equipment wie den PKE Geisterschocker und den Protonen-Strahler, wenn du die Geister bei diesem ultimativen Kampf gegen eine entsetzliche neue Bedrohung findest, vernichtest und fängst.

Ghostbusters ™ & © 2023 Columbia Pictures Industries, Inc. All Rights Reserved.

name: The Flip
summary: Schließ dich in The Flip, einem Koop-VR-Shooter in einer von Zombies überrannten Stadt, mit Freunden zu einem spannungsgeladenen Abenteuer zusammen. Finde Waffen und passe deinen Avatar an, während du gegen Kreep und seine Monster um das Überleben kämpfst. In The Flip, das für gemeinsames Spielen und einen schnellen Einstieg konzipiert ist, trittst du mit bis zu vier Personen an und kannst jederzeit loslegen oder aufhören. Dreh den Spieß um und bekämpfe die Zombieapokalypse!

name: ForeVR Pool
summary:
Fordere Freunde, Familie und Profi-NSC zu einem 8-Ball-Billardspiel heraus! Hol dir die coolsten Poolbillard-Hallen der Welt direkt ins Wohnzimmer. 

Sei bereit: ZIELEN, FIXIEREN UND STOSSEN!

🎱 50 Queues und 5 Hallen
🎱 Optional: Zielassistenten-Zielhilfe sowie Spieleinstellungen
🎱 Öffentliche und private 1-vs.-1-Mehrspielerpartien + Schnelles Spiel und lokales Reihum-Spiel
🎱 Bald verfügbar: 2-vs.-2-Mehrspieler!
🎱 12 Profi-NSC warten auf deine Herausforderung!
🎱 YouTube-Jukebox!

name: Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes
summary: Du befindest dich alleine in einem Raum mit einer Bombe. Deine Freunde haben das Handbuch, um sie zu entschärfen, aber sie können die Bombe nicht sehen, also müsst ihr euch absprechen - und zwar schnell!  Dieses lokale Mehrspielerspiel erfordert zwei oder mehr Spieler. Es wird nur ein VR-Headset mit dem Spiel benötigt.  Ein kostenloses Handbuch zur Bombenentschärfung, das unter www.bombmanual.com/de verfügbar ist, wird benötigt.

name: Softspace
summary: Softspace is an intuitive AR workspace where you lay out and organize notes, images, and websites. Connect related concepts, search the web for inspiration, and even get creative suggestions from our AI. This powerful productivity and creativity tool helps you develop the ideas at the heart of your best work.

name: Naer
Creator: No
summary: Fun, focused workshops for hybrid working teams

name: Noclip VR
summary: Noclip VR is a co-op multiplayer backrooms game with unique locomotion and gameplay. The horror game has many unique levels and entities from the backrooms.

name: Just Another Cooking Game
summary:
Just Another Cooking Game is a time management game inspired by several other cooking games such as Overcooked and Cook-Out. 
JACG is also part of a PhD research project focused on understanding what factors enhance immersion and presence in VR games. 
Play the experience to unlock 12 more levels.
Cook Under Pressure and see if you can handle the heat!

name: Horror
summary:
👻Treten Sie Discord bei: https://discord.com/invite/UpFwwnV6PZ, um KOSTENLOSE SCHLÜSSEL für das VOLLSTÄNDIGE SPIEL zu gewinnen!👻

Ein VR-Horror- und Rätselspiel, das Echtzeit-Voice-Chat und Online-Spiel für zwei Spieler unterstützt. Lass uns gemeinsam dieses mysteriöse Einkaufszentrum betreten, die Geheimnisse aufdecken, die Wahrheit erforschen und die Angst und Aufregung des Unbekannten erleben. Zögern Sie nicht, sich mit uns auf eine wahre Reise des Grauens zu begeben!

name: Masterpiece X
summary:
Simplify your 3D prototyping process! Create 3D models quickly and easily using VR and GenAI.

Designed for creativity, simplified for you:
- Jumpstart your 3D creation journey. No prior experience is needed.
- Say goodbye to complexity with our user-friendly interface.
- Use our text-to-3D generative AI to create prototype 3D assets with mesh, textures, and animations (human models only).

Embark on your 3D creation adventure – Get Masterpiece X today and transform your ideas into reality!

name: Yeeps: Hide and Seek
summary: Yeeps: Hide and Seek takes the best movement VR has to offer and builds on it, literally! Your belly is full of stuffing used to craft anything from pillows for building to bombs for destruction. Pull items from your vast imagination and toss them into the world. The game’s intuitive block-based building makes it easy to express your creativity at any skill level.

name: Sail Single Player
summary: Open World VR Pirate Game - FREE Single Player Experience

name: Monkeys Place
summary:
Monkeys, Monkeys, Monkeys!
who doesnt like Monkeys? you do like Monkeys! so why not playing a with Love made game with your friends?
The game is currently in Alpha. so if you find any Bugs you can join the discord given in the game and report it.

Hope you have fun playing it!

name: First Person Tennis - The Real Tennis Simulator
summary:
Welcome to the First Person Tennis, the first tennis simulator developed for VR.

First Person Tennis uses the most innovative physics engine to reproduce the real tennis shots in VR. Thanks to the support of a big community and professional tennis players, the game is in an endless development to reach an incredible level of realism.  

First Person Tennis is for all ages and tennis players, the simulator has different levels of difficulty and options for any need.

name: Mistika VR Connect
summary:
IMPORTANT: Mistika VR Connect is an add-on feature for Mistika VR.  To use it, you must connect the application with the host desktop version of Mistika VR. To learn more visit www.sgo.es/mistika-vr-connect 

Ready to take your immersive media creation to a whole new level? 

With Mistika VR Connect you’re able to stitch 360º/180º VR media directly in Meta Quest 2 headset, using some of the most popular features of the industry’s favorite optical flow stitching software Mistika VR.

name: HUMANITY
summary:
VR Game of the Year, The EDGE Awards 2023!

HUMANITY ist ein innovativer Mix aus Puzzle und Action-Plattformer. Das Schicksal der Menschheit liegt in deinen Händen bzw. Pfoten! Bringe im Story-Modus als Shiba Inu riesige Menschenmengen ans Ziel oder durchstöbere die Vielfalt an Nutzerlevels, die mit dem Leveleditor erstellt wurden!

name: Derby
summary:
Derby is the best place to meet friends, play ball, and make fun videos.

Enter a social virtual park, unleash your swing and throw heat!

Casually compete with friends in a 1v1, or become a champ on the leaderboards.

Earn Peanuts to spend in the Snack Shack on a rotating selection of swag. 

Become a member to earn exclusive rewards, and craft your own private park to host insane fan lobbies with friends.

Hit dingers, become a star, and change the game! It’s all possible in Derby.

name: SketchUp Viewer
summary: SketchUp Viewer for Meta Quest makes it easier than ever to view your SketchUp models in virtual reality and amaze your customers and stakeholders. Available now for Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, and Meta Quest Pro, you can experience your designs in an immersive environment without the need for a complex setup or a powerful desktop machine. Leverage features including Scenes, Outliner, Tape Measure, and our brand new Home Environment to showcase your designs and make better design decisions.

name: Tribe XR | DJ Academy
summary:
Become a DJ! Play on official Pioneer DJ equipment. Learn from the masters at the Pete Tong DJ Academy. Join daily workshops. Connect with the community. Perform to the world.

Subscribe for your free 7-day trial:
- Play on official Pioneer DJ equipment
- Learn from the masters at the Pete Tong DJ Academy
- Load your own music - including via Dropbox
- Access tracks from Beatport, Monstercat & Soundcloud Go+
- Join live workshops & multiplayer rooms
- Livestream to Twitch
- Cancel anytime

name: Immerse - Language Learning
summary:
🔥 Don't just study Spanish, French, or English — learn how to SPEAK it fluently with coworkers, friends, and family!

❤️ Immerse is the fastest growing immersive language learning platform trusted by thousands of members around the world!

💪 Get unlimited access to live group classes and AI-powered conversation practice for a fraction of the cost of online tutoring or traveling abroad.

🤑 Subscriptions start as low as $25/mo. Must be 18 or older. 

🥳 Start your 14 day free trial today!

name: Innerworld
summary:
Welcome to Innerworld: a virtual world where you can learn evidence-based mental health tools and receive support in a place where you can feel safe being yourself. Start your mental health journey today.
 
Work through life’s biggest challenges with guides certified in Cognitive Behavioral Immersion: a transformative approach to mental health support. 

Let’s find our way together.

Innerworld is currently for people who are able to speak English.

name: VirtualSpeech
summary:
Improve your communication skills with AI-powered avatars, real-time feedback, and realistic environments. Training on presentation skills, leadership, sales, difficult conversations, and other workplace skills.

Features include:
★ AI-powered roleplay conversations
★ Real-time feedback on performance
★ Record your presentations and body language
★ Practice in augmented and mixed reality (MR/AR)
★ 30+ training modules
★ Add your slides, notes, and questions
★ Wide range of supported courses

name: iB Cricket
summary: A sport with 2.5 billion fans across the world is now in VR as iB Cricket (vSport). Step into immersive world-class stadiums with thousands cheering for you and hit the ball out of the park. Our realistic physics makes it intuitive to learn the sport within 10 mins. Thousands of people from all over the world including non-cricketing nations have enjoyed playing iB Cricket. Hone your skills, compete in global tournaments & become a vSport star.

name: Paintball Playground
summary: A Sports/Shooter game where you compete against other players on SpeedBall, SpeedQB or Woodsball maps.

name: Xbox Cloud Gaming (Beta)
summary:
Play hundreds of high-quality Xbox games on Meta VR headsets with Game Pass. 

*Game Pass Ultimate: Subscription continues automatically at regular monthly price unless cancelled. Xbox Cloud Gaming (Beta): requires supported controller (sold separately); streaming limitations apply, server availability and wait times may vary. Subject to xbox.com/subscriptionterms.

name: Red Matter
summary: Red Matter offers unparalleled visuals in a VR puzzle adventure set on Saturn's moon, Rhea. As Agent Epsilon, explore a captivating, story-driven world filled with engaging puzzles and breathtaking environments. Utilize hi-tech tools to uncover secrets within a beautifully detailed dystopian Sci-Fi universe. Experience a narrative rich in intrigue and wonder, designed to captivate from start to finish. Red Matter isn't just a game—it's an unforgettable journey into the essence of VR

name: ZuseRunners
summary: (ZuseRunners) is a fun Multiplayer Game To Play With New People And Make New Friends

name: BIG BALLERS VR
Talespin
summary:
Welcome to Talespin—a gateway to virtual worlds built to support your personal and professional growth. Embark on an enriching journey with our vast library of immersive learning content, thoughtfully designed to mirror real-life situations so you can practice the most important skills to get ahead—skills often called “power skills,” or “human skills.”

Empower yourself with the human skills that AI can't replace. Together, we can build the foundation for your future.

name: Steam Link
summary:
Steam Link streamt Ihre Lieblingsspiele in Ihrer Steam-Bibliothek direkt von Ihrem Computer auf Ihr Meta-Quest-VR-Headset.

Installieren Sie heute noch die Steam-Link-App und fangen Sie an zu spielen!

name: Mindset
GYM CLASS - BASKETBALL VR
summary: 🏀🏈⚾ GYM CLASS is the top VR basketball & sports game. Experience NBA licensed team courts with full-court games, social worlds for pickup games with friends, and football & baseball stadiums. Rated best on Quest, GC delivers top-notch simulation physics, environments, gameplay, avatars, and cosmetics. Tag your opponents in a fast-paced match, or play rec games - GC is where ballers unite.

name: Maloka
summary: Welcome to Maloka, a VR mindfulness game where practice meets play. Travel to your own personal island where you’ll unite with your Spirit and embark on an immersive journey like no other. Find a practice that works for you with 100+ unique mindfulness experiences guided by Dr. Deepak Chopra, Sharon Salzberg, The Big Quiet, and more!

name: WIN Reality Baseball
summary:
WIN Reality: VR Baseball Training on Meta Quest

Get the training used by travel ball players, college athletes, pros to develop their skills and be game-ready. Hit game-speed pitching, practice in simulated games, and compete in live events. Use the WIN Bat Attachment to get on-field feel.

Improve your pitch recognition, swing timing, and swing biomechanics.

See improvements in batting average and pitch recognition within weeks.

Train at your own pace and from the comfort of your

name: Monkey Doo
summary:
🐒🫵Fan Made Update!

Live in the heart of the Bermuda Triangle with all your Monkey friends! Swing on vines, throw doo at your enemies, and climb everything! 

- Huge Maps: Explore the Bermuda Jungle, Floating Forests, Ancient Ruins, Lava Chasm, and more

- Unique Gamemodes: Be the first to collect 10 bananas or work together to fend off hordes of crocs -- new modes are coming all the time

- Monkey Apparel: Customize your body color, equip face & head cosmetics, and stylize your doo

name: Wolvic
summary: Wolvic is a secure, open source, and accessible web browser that brings all of the web’s vast information and applications to the world of XR, and enables rich immersive WebXR experiences on the web itself. With interfaces and interaction support designed for immersive headsets, Wolvic brings you the best of both the web and XR.

name: APES
summary:
Run around as a super goofy ape with friends (if you have any.) or strangers!
From a Gleaming Cave to a Tropical Getaway, so much is in store for you in APES.

name: Nanome
summary: Nanome is the ultimate interface for scientific discovery, starting with molecular data. With Nanome, top R&D labs conduct cutting-edge research but, Nanome isn’t just for experts, it’s also used by students and amateur scientists studying chemistry and biology. Anyone can build 3D molecules or simulate an entire protein made of hundreds of atoms, all in one collaborative environment. Transform the way you learn and design molecular structures with Nanome. Visit nanome.ai for more info.

name: VR Hockey Reborn
summary: VR Hockey is here. Meet one of the most realistic VR hockey experiences.

name: Zenith: Nexus
summary: Party up with friends in a free online action-adventure RPG! Slash mobs with magic and race across parkour challenges in quick session-based runs. Meet up with other players in the city to upgrade your gear or just hangout and shoot hoops before your next run. Sessions stays fresh with daily and weekly content rotations.

name: Fruit Ninja 2
summary:
Spüre das Gewicht der Klinge in deinen Händen und erlebe den befriedigenden Widerstand, wenn du durch die Früchte schneidest und saftige Explosionen und bunte Spritzer erzeugst.
 
• Die Modi "Classic", "Arcade" und "Zen" sind zurück und saftiger denn je!
• Benutze den Bogen, um eine ganz neue Technik zum Durchstechen von Früchten zu erlernen 
• Der rasante Rhythmusmodus fordert dich heraus, mit der Musik Schritt zu halten
• Teste deine Fähigkeiten gegen andere Ninjas!

name: Assassin’s Creed® Nexus VR
summary: Verkörpere drei legendäre Assassinen in diesem brandneuen Assassin’s Creed-Abenteuer mit vollem Umfang. Erlebe den packenden Parkour, den Rausch des Kampfes und die knisternde Anspannung in der Verstohlenheit aus erster Hand. Schlüpfe in die Rolle eines Assassinen wie nie zuvor. Enthülle neue Erinnerungen von Ezio Auditore, Kassandra und Connor, während du daran arbeitest, Abstergo daran zu hindern, dass sie die Macht erlangen, um den Glauben der Menschen zu manipulieren.

name: Monkey Mischief
summary: Monkey Mischief is a multiplayer locomotion based VR game for Meta Quest. You  can mess around with your friends or just be monkeys and climb the architecture! However, you can customize and make your monkey unique using cosmetics in our shop, and even purchase Nanas to be dripped out to the max! There are game-modes to also play with your friends to test your skills against each other! Have fun!

name: Virtual Virtual Reality 2
summary:
Give that mech a tune-up! Now with refined steering, quest guides, gameplay improvements and new content. Plus! Play matchmaker during the apocalypse and help lonely souls find their merge mate.

In this darkly funny action/adventure game, pilot your mech body through the chaos of a dying metaverse, rescuing abandoned avatars along the way. Each new avatar-roommate brings unique tools to aid your escape back to meatspace!

name: Gods of Gravity
summary: Gods of Gravity is a social, arcade-style RTS game where you compete in an epic showdown of celestial gods. Scoop up ships and fling them to capture a nearby planet, or open wormholes to teleport them across the solar system. Hold planets and moons to boost your production. Mine asteroids for the powerful resources within. And if you dare, capture the sun for the ultimate buff. Then send a massive fleet to conquer your enemy’s home planet. Last god standing wins.

name: On The Morning You Wake (To the End of The World)
summary:
On the Morning You Wake (to the End of the World) ist ein Virtual-Reality-Dokumentarfilm über einen falschen Raketenalarm :
Am 13. Januar 2018 um 08:08 Uhr bekamen 1,4 Millionen Bewohner:innen von Hawai'i folgende Warnung per SMS:
BEDROHUNG DURCH BALLISTISCHE RAKETE RICHTUNG HAWAII. SUCHEN SIE SOFORT SCHUTZ. DIES IST KEINE ÜBUNG.
Panik erfasste die Hawaiische Bevölkerung und deren Freunde und Verwandte auf der ganzen Welt, allen wurde bewusst, wie real die heutige nukleare Bedrohung ist.

name: Felix & Paul Studios 2024
summary:
Explore the vast and varied cinematic virtual reality worlds of EMMY award-winning Felix & Paul Studios.

Go from awe-inspiring romps through Jurassic World, to a first-hand tour of The White House. Join the patrons at historic Ben's Chili Bowl or step into Patrick Watson’s studio for an exclusive and intimate musical performance. 

Start now and see the portal grow with more Felix & Paul Studios’ award-winning work featuring top franchises, leaders and performers from around the world.

name: UNDERDOGS
summary:
Schnalle dir 5 Tonnen Metall um und stürze dich in eine finstere Szenerie aus UNDERGROUND MECH FIGHTS! Zerschlage, zerschmettere, und zerreiße deine Feinde - das ist pure Metall-auf-Metall-Gewalt in diesem physikbasierten Mech-Brawler.

Statte dich mit über 100 verschiedenen Gegenständen aus, zum Beispiel Kettensägen und Abbruchbirnen, die diese Straßen beherrschen und kämpfe dich unter dem Gebrüll der blutrünstigen Menge in der Nahrungskette nach oben.

Willkommen im Dschungel.

name: ShapesXR
summary:
ShapesXR is a creation and collaboration platform for remote teams.
In ShapesXR you start creating in 3D within minutes without prior experience.

Product teams use Shapes XR to design and prototype immersive apps and create storyboards and user flows in 3D.

ShapesXR especially shines on Meta Quest Pro and supports avatars with eye and mouth tracking, full-color passthrough, and Stylus controllers for commenting and quick sketching.

name: SHOOTOUT
summary:
SHOOTOUT is a free to play multiplayer shooter where you get to build your own weapons and abilities!

Explore the depth that this game has to offer and strategize in a PvE arena and then jump into 3v3 PvP Game Modes to battle it out with other players. 

Started off a match wanting to be a support but midway realize that you want to change your playstyle? You would have 19 parts to combine freely that make up over 1000 combinations!

name: Fracked
summary:
THE AWARD-WINNING ACTION BLOCKBUSTER RETURNS...MORE EXPLOSIVE THAN EVER

Before nDreams’ critically acclaimed Synapse and the frenetic chaos of Frenzies, there was Fracked. The original trailblazing VR action adventure that seamlessly collides relentless “run and cover” gunfights with free and fluid skiing and climbing. Uncompromising, audacious, and unashamedly stylish, Fracked grabs VR by the Touch Controllers to deliver a truly ass-kicking virtual reality experience!

name: Penguin Paradise
summary: Slide on in with your friends, and play around as a penguin in an arctic environment! Freeze each other with snowballs in Penguin Royale, race down a slippery track on sleds, hunt penguins as a Yeti or BE hunted, or just relax on the half-pipes with your skis. There's always something to do in paradise!

name: MAYA: The Birth of a Superhero
summary:
Winner of the ‘New Voices’ Special Jury Mention Prize at the 2023 Tribeca Festival, nominated for Festival de Cannes Compétition Immersive 2024 and SXSW XR Competition 2024. 

An immersive story following Maya, an ordinary 21st Century girl, as she transforms into a uniquely female superhero whose powers derive from menstruation.

Staring Indira Varma (Game of Thrones), Charithra Chandran (Bridgerton) it was created by renowed artist and activist, Poulomi Basu and co-directed with CJ Clarke.

name: X8
summary:
X8 is the FREE TO PLAY next generation Hero Shooter!

Executing its directive to assemble worthy opponents, the rogue mod X8 has collected characters from across different game franchises. Players embody a variety of heroes and engage in 5v5 VR battles to restore a path back to their worlds.

name: Gravity League
summary:
Welcome to the future of ball games! 

In a world where gravity is no longer a limitation, the Gravity League has become the ultimate test of skill and endurance for athletes from all corners of the galaxy.

The rules are simple: 2 players, 1 ball, zero gravity - the first player to get 11 goals wins.

So strap on your Gravity Gloves and get ready to take on the competition!

name: NHL SENSE ARENA
summary:
Available Plans:
- $29.99 - Base Game, or
- Training product subscription starting at $34/month (paid $399.99 annually)
Experience the thrill of ice hockey with NHL Sense Arena, the only NHL-licensed VR game simulation and training platform. Play as your favorite NHL team, and strive for victory in the NHL Season mode and the 2024 Stanley Cup Playoffs! Advance your skills with our training subscription, featuring over 100+ USA Hockey approved drills and plans, with extra arenas to explore.

name: Campfire
summary:
Campfire is the best way to communicate 3D information across the physical product lifecycle. Whether you're streamlining design reviews, sales presentations, or technical training, Campfire makes it easier than ever.

A NEW APPROACH Campfire is designed for the way people communicate most naturally – around things. Instead of sharing screenfuls of CAD, images, and text, you share interactive 3D content with your team around it, even if they're around the globe.

name: MiRacle Pool
summary: 🎱 The Premier Pool Simulator with the most realistic ball physics and easy cue stick handling, all made for mixed reality! Game Modes include: Single Player, Multiplayer, Private Matches, Mini Games, Daily Challenges and Practice Mode. Earn XP, rank up and unlock new table designs, balls, cues and more! Play in any size room you have!

name: Tank Arena: Ultimate League
summary:
- Tank Arena: Ultimate League bringt aufregende Updates!
- Deathmatch-Revolution: Von Pulse Tower zu einem Deathmatch.
- Neues Lounge-Erlebnis: Steige im Ranking auf und spiele Mini-Games.
- Training Ground: Teste 8 Panzer und ihre Fähigkeiten.
- Epische Features: Bildet 4er-Teams für futuristische Kämpfe.
- Soziale Interaktion: Triff neue Freunde im Lounge und füge sie hinzu.

name: ForeVR Cornhole
summary:
ForeVR den ganzen Sommer!

Erlebe die für alle Würfe und Strategien maßgeschneiderte Bag-Physik mit so viel Realismus wie möglich.

🌽 Über 50 einzigartige Bags und Boards
🌽 5 Hallen
🌽 Herausforderbare Profi-NSC in jeder Halle
🌽 YouTube-Jukebox
🌽 Private und öffentliche Mehrspielerpartien
🌽 Teamspiele für 1v1 oder 2v2

Bags, Sack Toss, Dummy Boards, Beanbag Toss … Wie man es auch nennt, es ist das beste Rasenspiel der Welt. ForeVR Cornhole ist das beste (und erste!) Cornhole-Spiel in VR!

name: First Touch for Meta Quest Touch Pro controllers
summary: Grab your Meta Quest Touch Pro controllers and learn how they can improve your experience with this short tutorial. Enter your studio and enjoy the simple pleasure of painting in a nice, relaxing environment.

name: Tiger Blade
summary:
CHALLENGES UPDATE #3 ist live und führt zwei neue Levels in den Herausforderungsmodus des Spiels ein: Survival 2 und Twin's Lair.

---

Schlüpfe in einem alternativen Korea in die Rolle eines tödlichen Attentäters, der ein seltenes Tigerbaby stiehlt. Nehme an adrenalingeladenen Schwert- und Pistolenkämpfen teil, erkunde detaillierte Umgebungen und brenne deinen Namen in die Online-Ranglisten ein. Werde der ultimative koreanische Actionheld!

name: Hoame
summary:
Meditate, move, and breathe with us to live a happier life! Start your 7-day FREE trial today and unlock your full potential.  

NEW UPDATE: MIXED REALITY
Customize your meditation studio and enjoy your favourite classes.
 
FACE-TO-FACE GUIDANCE
Enjoy 350+ guided meditations with expert instructors.

MINDFULNESS IN MOTION
Move with intention in our mind-body workout, Rise!
 
BREATHE EASY
Breathe life into your practice with breathwork classes.

Start your journey today. See you on the cushion!

name: Aim XR
summary: Fast-paced multiplayer, run-and-gun shooter. 6v6 players

name: Witchblood
summary:
Erkunde in diesem atemberaubenden Mixed-Reality-Abenteuer, das von Metroid® und Castlevania® inspiriert ist, ein komplexes Diorama voller verborgener Schätze, herausfordernder Rätsel, furchterregender Gegner und mächtiger Magie.

Mit über 6 Stunden Erkundung und Kampf, Hunderten von Räumen, 40 Upgrades und 4 Schwierigkeitsstufen, die es zu meistern gilt, überträgt Witchblood klassisches Gaming in die virtuelle Realität.

name: Little Cities
summary:
Setze dein Headset auf und tauche in die charmante Welt des gemütlichen VR-Städtebauspiels Little Cities ein.
Kreiere deine Stadt und lasse sie vor deinen Augen zum Leben erwachen. Beobachte die Bewohner auf deiner Insel, die vom verschlafenen Dorf zur lebhaften Metropole heranwächst. Plane und erschaffe eine Stadt, in der man liebend gerne wohnt. Einfach zu lernen, aber so viel zu entdecken, verwirkliche mit Little Cities deine größten Ideen!

name: Painting VR
summary:
Take a break from the stress of daily life with this must-have virtual painter’s studio. Even if you think you’re not a creative person, Painting VR might prove you wrong. 

Be amazed by what you can create in this hands-on experience with unlimited supplies of paint, canvases, and all the tools you need.

name: Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station
summary:
Epic action-adventure is back. Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station raises the stakes. Check out the refined movement and combat system, evade obstacles, and see what surprises the new space journey will bring.  
Taste new challenges, use new items, and discover the secret of the abandoned base.
It's a mix of arcade, parkour, and puzzles, metroidvania style. It's an experience that has never been deeply explored in VR before.

name: Retreat
summary: Ready to level up your skills, have fun, and meet new people? You don't want to miss this amazing opportunity! Think of it like an adult summer camp - with courses from top experts in Art & Creativity, Career & Entrepreneurship, Financial Well-Being to Holistic Wellness. Get exclusive access and ask questions directly from world renowned instructors who are sharing decades worth of their expertise through immersive experiences. Upgrade your real world Avatar, that is you!

name: Figmin XR | Mixed Reality
summary:
Create, Collect & Play in Mixed Reality!

Figmin XR is a fun spatial computing application that lets you create your own mixed reality scenes. Multiplayer supported.

name: Zero Caliber 2
summary: 8+ hour single player/Co-op campaign, cinematic action, explosions, 59+ weapons and skins to unlock, PvP, mods, airstrikes, all in one single package - this is Zero Caliber 2, the sequel to our critically acclaimed Zero Caliber: Reloaded military shooter. See you on the virtual battlefields! o7

name: PatchWorld - Multiplayer Music Maker
summary: Discover the ultimate VR playground in PatchWorld! Create and explore boundless worlds, build your dream music studio, and connect with friends globally. Now bring your Ready Player Me avatars. Unique to Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest Pro: Capture your mixed reality adventures and musical creations and share on social media.

name: MLK: Now is the Time
summary:
Dr. Martin Luther King's iconic "I Have a Dream" speech contains messages that still resonate today, sixty years later.  
 
“MLK: Now is the Time” is an immersive journey that explores key themes of Dr. King's speech and highlights systemic inequities that persist in our society. Through first-person stories and interactions, “MLK: Now is the Time” drops you into a thoroughly modern interpretation of a contemporary March on Washington that will inform and inspire a new generation of activists.

name: Ultimechs
summary:
Die Torzonen leuchten auf. Die Menge brüllt. Ein perfekt entwickelter, von dir gesteuerter Mech betritt die Arena. Ultimechs ist ein kostenloses VR-Spiel, in dem Spieler in der Sportart der Zukunft Hochleistungsmechs aus der Ferne steuern können, während sie rasen, schlagen und punkten, um den Sieg zu erringen. 

Ultimechs – ein Spiel mit großen Robotern und noch größeren Toren von den Sportskanonen bei Resolution Games.

name: Deisim
summary: Lebe die Erfahrung, ein allmächtiger Gott zu sein. Erschaffe deine eigene Welt und führe die Menschheit von der Steinzeit bis zur Neuzeit und darüber hinaus.

name: Warplanes: Air Corp
summary:
Rule the skies of modern battlefield. Pilot fighter jets, helicopters and a variety of military aircraft.

● The third installment of the hit Warplanes series that takes us to the modern battlefield.
● Acquire machines inspired by the best military aircraft and helicopters from around the world.
● Play solo or fight online in co-op or classic PvP multiplayer.
● Surpass your enemies thanks to friendly flight model, intuitive controls and advanced targeting systems.

name: Noda
summary: Noda: Unleash your creativity and productivity with AI-powered immersive ideation. Build and share 3D mental models, from mind maps to logic flow diagrams. Import data, web content, and export your vision in a spatial understanding. Explore your mind in a whole new dimension.

name: Kartoffl
summary: Kartoffl ist ein lächerlich süßes, aber herausforderndes VR-Puzzlespiel mit Lemmings-ähnlichen vibes.

name: Asgard's Wrath 2
summary: Lokis Chaos breitet sich aus. Verfolge ihn in diesem epischen VR-ARPG mit sterblichen Helden und ihren einzigartigen Waffen und Spielstilen durch uralte ägyptische Reiche der Götter. Erkunde diese riesige, frei begehbare, lebende Weld und bekämpfe tödliche mythische Kreaturen, gehe auf Quests, fertige, löse Rätsel und mache Tiere zu Kampfgefährten. Das Schicksal der Realität liegt in dieser mit Spannung erwarteten Fortsetzung eines der bestbewerteten VR-Spiele aller Zeiten in deinen Händen.

name: Meta Horizon Worlds
summary: Willkommen bei Meta Horizon Worlds! Ganz gleich, ob du eine Community, Games, Events oder von allem etwas suchst – diese App ist der ideale Ort dafür. Mit immer wieder neuen Welten und Quests gibt es stets etwas zu entdecken.

name: ZuseRunners
Hints for room creation: fun Multiplayer Game To Make New Friends And Explore a bunch of new places

name: Resolve
Creator: No
summary: Resolve allows teams building complex construction projects to review large BIM projects on the Meta Quest in a collaborative environment. Resolve’s ability to handle the biggest 3D models enables teams to simulate maintenance, safety and accessibility issues earlier than ever before. From cutting edge biopharma facilities to wind farms and data centers, Resolve delivers unparalleled performance on wireless VR headsets without the need to section your model, stream, or use a hefty PC.

name: Wooorld
summary:
Dive into Wooorld, an immersive social platform bringing a 3D map of the world into your room in Mixed Reality. Explore cities, landmarks, natural wonders with rich content from Wikipedia and Google Maps. Challenge yourself with the location guessing game "Where in the Wooorld". Plan trips with the help of a global community of explorers. Enjoy AI-powered Tours, customizations, safety & accessibility features.

Enjoy Wooorld for Free, or unlock premium features with Explorer+ & Player+ add-ons.

name: Autodesk Workshop XR
Creator: No
summary: Immersive workspace, connected to Autodesk Construction Cloud | Review and collaborate in your 3D models.
